timecoded_text_to_speech.text: I'm Fiona Morrison and I'm hoping to become Kiddlington's second green counsellor after
the elections on the 5th of May.
As a Green counsellor I work for you and not for my political party.
As a Kiddlington parish counsellor I've enjoyed working on
community projects and looking out for local residents, especially during the
last few difficult years. I hope you'll give me your support so that you can do
even more as your district counsellor. Please vote green on May the 5th.

youtube_description: Fiona has achieved a lot for the community as a parish councillor. Now she is asking for votes to do more as a Cherwell district councillor.
